parent: Completed corrected-input longitudinal v2, exposed DEV
objective: Distinguish route selection from the deployed expert output pattern after corrected-input comparisons did not show an MDU advantage.
inputs: Ten fixed unique queries: all four admitted native sources and all six fixed probes; use exact already-verified RGB display images/questions from v2.

design.forced_original: All four frozen MDU experts crossed with all ten original queries:40 generations. Own source first for each expert, must exactly replay prior source tokens.
design.reversed_natural: Reverse only the two image paths for all ten queries and use actual R0:10 generations; compare selection/tokens to existing natural original outputs.

gates: All ten original R0 decisions must replay existing v2 choices
Four forced own-source outputs must replay existing v2 tokens
Original prompt IDs and ordered pair identities equal v2; reversed identities must differ

budgets.wall: Shared original start1794146646.4666255; diagnostic deadline=min(original1794229446.4666255, launch+2h); no reset of longitudinal experiment budget

metrics: Literal full-token equality, selected expert identity, exact source-category answer counts, EOS/caps; no new clinical accuracy scores or reversal gold.
selection: No candidate/seed/label/prompt/window/step search, no training, no baseline optimization, no UNKNOWN retry; preserve own-method canonical banks read-only.
limitations: Forced crossing changes question and images together; it does not by itself isolate image causality.
Image-order reversal is an intervention without newly adjudicated medical labels.
All source/probe patients exposed; no independent verification or superiority claim.
stop: First replay/resource failure preserves evidence and stops; no implicit generation replay or expansion.
publication: Source and aggregate diagnostics only; private pairs/questions/raw answers/tokens/weights remain private.
